custodyProfile.uncertainty: The immediate parent-token custody is identified; whole-book upstream legal segregation, custodian allocation, independent financial reconciliation and holder seniority are not established by this local balance observation. Custodian owner is the factory proxy. Its current implementation has no generic recovery forwarder; the shared Safe owns the factory ProxyAdmin and custodian beacon, so reserve code remains replaceable. The current BrandedCustodian recoverERC20 function has no reserve-token exclusion.
